reader.requirement: At --std 85 every argument-1 of FUNCTION RANGE must be of class numeric: an arithmetic expression, a numeric item of any usage, a numeric literal, ZERO, or a numeric or integer function, including a table(ALL) list over OCCURS DEPENDING ON. An alphanumeric item or literal, a numeric-edited item, a reference-modified numeric item (class alphanumeric at 1985) and a non-ZERO figurative constant must be refused. The witness covers items, literals and expressions; it does not cover ZERO, table(ALL), nested functions, the largest item or the refusal half.
